limitations: Exact Vercel build-log duration and runtime-log rows were not captured and are not claimed.
No new full-site WCAG, field-performance, or security penetration audit is claimed; release-specific regression evidence is proportional to the non-runtime research scope.
The historical per-taxon provider-count feature is a reproducible archive proxy for a pre-request limit=0 count, not a retained historical as-of response.
plainEnglishSummary: The authorized audit checkpoint is live at the exact intended commit and production deployment. The new model is materially less wrong than the old heuristic, but uncertainty coverage is inadequate, so no new GBIF request is allowed. The known negative-evidence candidates also provide zero unresearched movement, so that acquisition lane remains closed. The existing Round 77 R2 data release remains unchanged.
